name: public-docs
description: Cloudflare Worker runtime shell for the public documentation surface.

scripts.build: pnpm run ensure:docs-scaffold && rspress build && pnpm run build:clean-routes
scripts.build:real-docs: pnpm run sync:real-docs && pnpm run lint:generated && pnpm run build
scripts.dev:real-docs: pnpm run sync:real-docs && pnpm run lint:generated && pnpm run dev
scripts.build:published-reader-assets: pnpm run sync:published-reader-docs && pnpm run lint:generated && pnpm run build && pnpm run sync:published-reader-assets
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:published-reader-assets && pnpm deploy:verify-config && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm run build:published-reader-assets && pnpm deploy:verify-config:staging && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --env staging --config wrangler.toml
